Prove required denominator positivity and monotonicity rather than importing an unproved paper lemma or introducing an axiom.'},
    {'id': 'combined_coefficients', 'description': 'Compose the two recurrence expansions to assign each original term an explicitly constructed coefficient c_i. Prove its factor count is at most K=T+n_dagger-1 and deduce abs(c_i-1)<=gamma_K from the rounding witnesses and the product helper. Establish the exact computed identity y_hat = sum_i x_i*y_i*c_i from the actual recurrences and padding/indexing lemmas.'},
    {'id': 'perturbation_construction', 'description': 'Construct Delta_x(i)=(c_i-1)*x_i and Delta_y(i)=(c_i-1)*y_i as functions on the original input index type. Do not interpret the claim as simultaneously perturbing both factors in one product; no division by x_i or y_i is needed.'},
    {'id': 'formal_validation', 'description': 'Compile the complete formalization with local Lean and Mathlib, with no sorry, custom axioms, or assumed algorithmic bounds.   ],

}
